say:2:1720711001:1.text: Rowan, put the money down and check out my new outfit!
say:2:1720711001:1.source_cn: 喂！罗万！别数钱了！快来看看本小姐的新装扮！

say:5:1720711003:1.text: ... That tone and expression are already getting on my nerves... Peggy, is that you?!
say:5:1720711003:1.source_cn: ……这语气，这神态，还有这种让人莫名火大的感觉……佩吉...

say:7:1720711004:1.text: You're sharp! That's right, I'm... Lady Penny today!
say:7:1720711004:1.source_cn: 嘿嘿，算你聪明！没错，就是本……本小姐！今天你别叫我佩...

say:8:1720711005:1.text: What's with this look? Ah, I get it. Since you're with <style="stress"><player_name></style>, it must be magic at work...
say:8:1720711005:1.source_cn: 你怎么变成这副样子了？哦，我明白了，既然你和<styl...

say:8:1720711005:1.female: What's with this look? Ah, I get it. Since you're with <style="stress"><player_name></style>, it must be magic at work...

say:9:1720711006:1.text: ... And what are you doing here? Shouldn't you be preparing for your birthday banquet?
say:9:1720711006:1.source_cn: ……等等，你来这里干什么？这个时间点，你不是应该在准备...

say:10:1720711007:1.text: I hate banquets, and I'm calling mine off! Anyway, I'm here to collect what you owe me. You haven't forgotten, have you?
say:10:1720711007:1.source_cn: 生日宴会什么的最烦人了，我要取消！今天我是来收债的，你...

document:11:551:0.text:
I, Rowan of the Mithril Consortium, hereby make this formal declaration:
In the Grand Royal Supreme Card Tournament today, I suffered an unfortunate (and likely arranged) defeat at the hands of Princess Peggy.
I accept the loss and, of my own free will, shall unconditionally serve as Princess Peggy's errand boy for one day at any time she chooses in the future.

My duties shall include, but not limited to:
Carry bags (up to 10 kg).
Pay bills (only reasonable amounts and items).
Compliment Princess Peggy's wisdom and beauty whenever necessary (even if I don't mean it).

This serves as formal proof of my pledge.
<align="right">Debtor: Rowan (shaky signature)
<align="right">Creditor: Peggy (smug signature)
document:11:551:0.source_cn:
本人，秘银商会罗万在此郑重承诺：
因在今日的“皇家至尊无敌超级纸牌大赛”中，不幸（且极有可能是被针对地）败给了佩吉公主。
本人愿赌服输，自愿在未来任意一天的任意时刻，无条件响应佩吉公主的召唤，并担任其专属跟班一日。
跟班职责包括但不限于：
拎包（限重10公斤以内）。
买单（仅限合理的金额和商品范围内）。
在佩吉公主需要的时候，大声赞美她的智慧与美貌（可以违心地说）。
特此立据，绝不赖账！
<align="right">欠债人：罗万（颤抖的签名）
<align="right">债权人：佩吉（得意洋洋的签名）

say:12:1720711008:1.text: It's right here in black and white! You're my errand boy today!
say:12:1720711008:1.source_cn: 白纸黑字，罗万少爷，今天你是我的跟班了！

say:13:1720711009:1.text: ... Tsk, what was I thinking when I agreed to this?
say:13:1720711009:1.source_cn: ……啧，失策了。当初就不应该签这个不平等条约。

say:14:1720711010:1.text: Alright, I'll keep my word, but let me tie up some loose ends here first. As a businessman, integrity comes first.
say:14:1720711010:1.source_cn: 行行行，我认账。不过，我得先把手头的生意处理完。生意人...
